title: 第15章 中心大厦第16章 巡逻
content_zh:
听到金丹真人这四个字，车上的赵天行便是微微一惊，接着又不信道“金丹真人的女儿怎么会来嵩阳？”
张羽也在一旁微微点头，他知道炼气之上是筑基，筑基之上才是金丹。
想要成就金丹，必然是重点高中毕业，顺利考入十大名校，还进入大宗门一路发展，也不知道要爬上昆墟的第几层了。
这种人的女儿，一出生起码也是昆墟二层往上，怎么会来到一层的嵩阳市？
司机闻言微微一笑，却像是起了卖弄的心思，缓缓说道“岂止是李雪莲女士要来我嵩阳市？”
“据说其父星火真人就是从我们嵩阳市出来的，现在是要退休了，这才打算回到嵩阳市颐养天年……”
张羽听着却觉得怪怪的，金丹大能回新手村养老？
司机这边则是接着说道“这次画展可不止是李女士的画，据说还有一副星火真人亲绘的天人演武图，其中据说隐藏了一套绝世武学。”
“来这次画展的人里，除了想要结交李女士的之外，便还有许多都想要参悟一番这演武图，想要从中悟出那一套绝世武学。”
……
嵩阳中心大厦。
第999层。
张羽正站在落地窗前，有些震撼地看着脚下的滚滚云海，这还是他第一次站在如此高空去俯瞰整座城市。
整了整身上新换上的保安服，张羽心中有些感叹。
自从进入中心大厦以来，张羽便感觉自己像是来到了另一个梦幻世界。
如果说他住的郊区环境还有点类似前世的话，那么嵩阳高中的基建环境就已经隐隐在各方面都超越了上一世的世界，而眼前的中心大厦……
不论那999层的恐怖高度，还是大厦内充满了法力流转的种种仙道技术，都称得上是梦幻般的场景。
回想自己在道术加持下，几秒钟内就被阵法牵引至999层，却又毫发无伤的过程，张羽心中便忍不住再生感慨。
“同样都是嵩阳市，凡人住在郊区，修仙者汇聚于市中心，而这座中心大厦则是真正有钱人的地盘了。”
“三个地方，虽然都在一座城市之中，却犹如三个不同的分层世界……”

就在这时，张羽身后响起了赵天行的声音“张羽，队长让我们过来巡逻的，得走了吧？”
张羽转过头去，看向身后同样穿着保安服的赵天行。
只不过和张羽穿了保安服后的坦然不同，赵天行却是十分局促，畏畏缩缩……一副屎拉在裤子里的衰样。
他总觉得穿上了这套保安服后像个小丑，周围的人看向他的目光中都像是带着三分鄙夷、三分蔑视、三分轻贱。
但其实是赵天行想多了，穿上这套保安服后，他就再也不是凡人，就像是成为了大厦里的背景板，在大多部分人眼中的存在感也就略高于绿化。
张羽一拍他的肩膀，说道“挺胸抬头，咱们现在是中心大厦的保安，又不是来送外卖的，你怕什么。”
感觉到四周围的路人似乎都被张羽的说话声吸引了过来，赵天行连忙说道“我知道了，张羽你说话声音轻点，别影响到别人。”
这次画展的规模不小，占据了上千平米的场地，还供应了酒水和自助用餐，在张羽看来与其说是来看画，更像是一种聚会。
而那传说中的天人演武图此刻便被一层幕布覆盖，据说要等李雪莲女士亲自来揭开。
张羽便和赵天行被分到这片场地里较靠边的一处，作为保安来回巡逻。
而此刻画展都尚未正式开始，这巡逻也显得轻松无比，更没有引起仪式反噬。
毕竟张羽身上的仪式力量针对的是完成愿望的事情。
而他要完成愿望的方法则是学习，修炼，努力考上大学，工作赚钱……最终来完成邪神的愿望。
像是临时工作这一类的事情也是工作赚钱乃至学习修炼的一部分，仪式力量并不会逼迫着他转去做别的事情。
反倒是此刻没事瞎转悠的状态，对张羽来说反而比这几天的苦修轻松了太多太多。
就在这时，两人靠近餐桌这边的时候，便看到一群侍者正在摆放餐盘，整理桌面装饰。
张羽瞄了一眼，看着那一碟子一碟子被摆放出来的菜色，惊讶道“这是……海鲜？”
赵天行也望了过去，看了看餐盘里的鲍鱼龙虾……微微点头“是海洋生物，那个带壳的我跟我妈出去的时候看到过，好像一斤就要三、四万呢。”
content_en:
Hearing the words Jin Dan Zhenren, Zhao Tianxing in the car was slightly startled, and then he didn't believe it, "Why did Jin Dan Zhenren's daughter come to Songyang?"
Zhang Yu also nodded slightly. He knew that above the Qi refining was the foundation, and above the foundation was the golden elixir.
If you want to achieve the golden elixir, you must graduate from a key high school, successfully enter one of the top ten prestigious schools, and enter a large sect to develop all the way. You don't know which level of Kunxu you have to climb to.
The daughter of such a person was at least on the second floor of Kunxu when she was born. How could she come to Songyang City on the first floor?
The driver smiled slightly when he heard this, but seemed to be showing off, and said slowly, "Isn't it just Ms. Li Xuelian who wants to come to Songyang City?"
"It is said that his father, Master Xinghuo, came from our Songyang City. Now that he is retiring, he plans to return to Songyang City to take care of himself..."
Zhang Yu felt strange when he heard this. Can Jin Dan go back to Novice Village to take care of his old age?
The driver continued, "This art exhibition is not just about Ms. Li's paintings. It is said that there is also a picture of heaven and man performing martial arts drawn by Master Xinghuo. It is said that there is a set of peerless martial arts hidden in it."
"Among the people who come to this art exhibition, in addition to those who want to make friends with Ms. Li, there are also many who want to understand the martial arts painting and understand the peerless martial arts from it."
…
Songyang Center Building.
Level 999.
Zhang Yu was standing in front of the floor-to-ceiling window, looking at the rolling sea of ​​clouds under his feet with some shock. This was the first time he stood at such a high altitude and overlooked the entire city.
After adjusting his newly put on security uniform, Zhang Yu sighed in his heart.
Since entering the central building, Zhang Yu felt as if he had entered another dream world.
If the suburban environment where he lives is still a bit similar to his previous life, then the infrastructure environment of Songyang High School has surpassed the previous world in all aspects, and the central building in front of him...
Regardless of the terrifying height of the 999th floor, or the various immortal techniques that circulate mana in the building, it can be called a dreamlike scene.
Recalling the process in which he was pulled to the 999th level by the formation within a few seconds with the blessing of Taoism, but was unscathed, Zhang Yu couldn't help but sigh in his heart.
"It's also Songyang City. Mortals live in the suburbs, while cultivators gather in the city center. This central building is the territory of the truly wealthy."
"Three places, although they are all in the same city, are like three different layered worlds..."
At this moment, Zhao Tianxing's voice sounded from behind Zhang Yu, "Zhang Yu, the captain asked us to come over for patrol. We have to go, right?"
Zhang Yu turned his head and looked at Zhao Tianxing behind him who was also wearing security uniform.
It's just that unlike Zhang Yu who was calm after wearing the security uniform, Zhao Tianxing was very cramped and timid... as if he had shit in his pants.
He always felt like a clown after putting on this security uniform, and the people around him looked at him with three parts contempt, three parts contempt and three parts contempt.
But in fact, Zhao Tianxing was overthinking it. After putting on this security uniform, he was no longer a mortal. It was as if he had become the background of the building. In the eyes of most people, his presence was slightly higher than that of greenery.
Zhang Yu patted him on the shoulder and said, "Put your chest up and your head up. We are the security guards of the central building now, and we are not here to deliver food. What are you afraid of?"
Feeling that the passers-by around him seemed to be attracted by Zhang Yu's voice, Zhao Tianxing said quickly, "I understand, Zhang Yu, please speak softly, so as not to affect others."
The scale of this art exhibition was quite large, occupying thousands of square meters of space, and also provided drinks and buffet meals. In Zhang Yu's opinion, it was more like a party than a visit to see paintings.
The legendary picture of heaven and man performing martial arts is now covered by a curtain, and it is said that it will wait for Ms. Li Xuelian to unveil it in person.
Zhang Yu and Zhao Tianxing were assigned to a place closer to the venue as security guards.Return to patrol.
At this moment, the art exhibition has not officially started yet, and the patrol seems very relaxed, and it has not caused any ritual backlash.
After all, Zhang Yu's ritual power was aimed at fulfilling wishes.
The way he wants to fulfill his wish is to study, practice, work hard to get into college, work and make money... and finally fulfill the evil god's wish.
Things like temporary work are also part of working to make money and even learning and practicing. The power of rituals will not force him to do other things.
On the contrary, the current state of wandering around with nothing to do was much easier for Zhang Yu than the hard training of the past few days.
At this moment, when the two of them approached the dining table, they saw a group of waiters placing plates and arranging table decorations.
Zhang Yu glanced at the dishes placed on the plate and said in surprise, "Is this...seafood?"
Zhao Tianxing also looked over and looked at the abalone and lobster on the dinner plate...nodding slightly, "It's a marine creature. I saw the shelled one when I went out with my mother. It seems to cost thirty or forty thousand per pound."
